title: Payment API timeout latency
text: For payment API timeouts and high latency, compare p95 latency and error rate against the service SLO. Check downstream bank dependencies and connection pool saturation. Do not blindly retry payment writes; use the original idempotency key. Escalate sustained failures to the incident commander.

title: Authentication unauthorized token expired
text: For unauthorized responses or expired authentication tokens, verify token expiry, issuer, audience and workload identity configuration. Check IAM or Entra role assignments. Never disable authentication or copy production credentials to a pipeline.

title: Capacity CPU memory throttling
text: For high CPU, memory pressure or throttling, inspect pod resource requests and limits, HPA metrics and node capacity. Check pending pods and quota before scaling. An OOMKilled container needs memory investigation; raising replicas alone may not fix it.

title: Release rollback deployment failed
text: For a failed application release, stop promotion and identify the last healthy Helm revision. Review error rate and readiness checks, then perform an approved Helm rollback. Verify smoke tests and SLO recovery. Image, model and prompt versions must roll back together.

title: Duplicate payment idempotency
text: For duplicate payment reports, correlate the request ID with its idempotency key and transaction status. Do not resubmit a transaction until its existing outcome is known. Escalate suspected double settlement to payment operations.
